info.title: LiteNAS File Service
info.description: Authenticated file browsing, downloads, uploads, and filesystem operations. The public paths below are served by Nginx. File Service validates requests through Auth and RBAC except for the documented authenticated cross-user avatar read policy. Host paths are absolute Unix paths represented as slash-delimited URL suffixes. For browser cookie mutations, send a same-origin Origin or Referer header. Operation jobs live only while File Service runs.

bearerAuth.description: Alternative to the existing browser cookie.

browserCookie.name: lite-nas-at
browserCookie.description: Secure HttpOnly cookie issued by the LiteNAS login flow. Browser requests send it automatically on the same origin.

absolutePath.name: absolutePath
absolutePath.description: Greedy slash-delimited suffix of an absolute host path, without its first slash. Example: home/alice/photo.jpg maps to /home/alice/photo.jpg. Encode individual segments, not their separating slashes. Some Swagger clients encode slashes in path parameters; use the equivalent curl command when that happens.

uploadId.name: uploadId
uploadId.description: Opaque upload ID returned by upload creation; the ID is not a credential.

jobId.name: id
jobId.description: Opaque operation job ID returned by copy, move, or directory deletion; the ID is not a credential.

range.name: Range
range.description: One RFC 9110 byte range. Multiple ranges are not supported.

ifRange.name: If-Range
ifRange.description: Serve the range only if the supplied ETag still matches.

ifMatch.name: If-Match
ifMatch.description: Reject the request when the file ETag changed.

value.description: Value actually embedded in the source file.

HostPath.description: Clean absolute Unix path. No NUL, ambiguous components, or traversal.

Transfer.description: Destination is the complete target path, including the entry name.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the complete original file.

chunk_size.description: Optional requested chunk size in bytes. Defaults to the service setting; only the final PATCH chunk may be shorter.

resource.description: Public /f path of the published file.

BadRequest.description: Invalid path, metadata, or request body.

Unauthenticated.description: Missing or invalid LiteNAS access token.

Forbidden.description: Policy or RBAC denied the operation, or cookie mutation failed the same-origin check.

NotFound.description: Resource missing or hidden from this subject.

Conflict.description: Target changed, is busy, has the wrong type, or operation cannot proceed.

Unavailable.description: Authentication, authorization, job queue, storage, or upload capacity unavailable.

Precondition.description: If-Match did not match the current file ETag.

InvalidRange.description: Range is invalid or cannot be satisfied; Content-Range reports the current file size.

DownloadLimit.description: Concurrent download limit reached for this principal and file.

get.description: Authenticates the current user and repeats File Service read authorization for this path. Dimensions are returned when the built-in decoder supports the image. Tags contain only fields read from the source; an empty array is valid. Live Photo pairing is gallery-level work, not asserted by this single-file operation.

200.description: Source-backed metadata for an authorized regular file.

get.description: Returns the File Service canonical path and kind after a fresh Auth/RBAC read check. Moments uses this to validate gallery source references.
Returns only entries individually allowed by RBAC. A denied root listing is an error, not an empty listing. Query flags are enabled by presence, including ?recursive and ?files-only.

parameters.name: recursive
parameters.description: If present, recursively visit accessible subdirectories.

parameters.name: files-only
parameters.description: If present, omit directory objects from the response.

200.description: Authorized file and directory objects with nullable filesystem metadata.

get.description: Text, PDF, and supported image extensions may render inline; other types are attachments. The ETag identifies the selected file version. A fixed /home/<username>/.lite-nas/avatar.image is readable by authenticated users when it is owned by the named user, world-readable, and a valid PNG/JPEG; other files use ordinary RBAC read decisions.

head.description: Returns the same metadata and range status as GET without a body.

200.description: Complete-file metadata with ETag, Content-Length, Content-Type, and Content-Disposition headers.

delete.summary: Delete a file or queue recursive directory deletion
delete.description: Regular-file deletion is immediate. Directory deletion checks each descendant and queues an in-memory job. Symlinks and special files are rejected.

204.description: Regular file deleted; no response body.

get.summary: Download an authorized file as an attachment
get.description: Same file as /f/{absolutePath}, always served as application/octet-stream with attachment disposition. Supports one byte range and ETag conditions.

post.description: The destination form part MUST precede the file part so authorization completes before file bytes are accepted. Maximum file content is 10 GiB. This route does not support resume. Swagger UI may reorder multipart fields; use a client that preserves part order when needed.

get.description: Call before PATCH when managing concurrent uploads. Capacity can change between this response and reservation.

200.description: Available buffer capacity and maximum chunk size.

post.summary: Create or recover a resumable upload
post.description: An Idempotency-Key repeated with identical metadata returns the existing upload (200); changing metadata under the same key returns 409. The destination is the complete file path. The client computes whole-file SHA-256 before creation.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 8–128 characters; stable across retries of the same upload initialization.

200.description: Existing upload with the same idempotency key and metadata.
Committed progress and effective chunk size.

head.description: Returns Upload-Length, Upload-Offset, Upload-Next-Chunk-Index, and for active uploads Upload-Chunk-Size; no body.

patch.description: Send exactly the upload's recorded chunk size except for the final chunk. Replaying the last acknowledged bytes at the prior offset is idempotent. The service reserves buffer capacity before reading the body.

parameters.name: Upload-Offset
parameters.description: Committed offset returned by the previous PATCH or progress query.

204.description: Chunk durably committed or idempotently replayed.

503.description: Upload window full or service unavailable; retry after probing capacity.

delete.description: Removes only the identified stage and metadata; a completed upload cannot be cancelled.

put.summary: Verify and publish a resumable upload
put.description: Requires all bytes committed and matching whole-file SHA-256. Publication is atomic for one file. A retry after successful completion returns the same completed resource.

post.description: Creates one absent directory under an existing parent. Existing directories return a conflict rather than succeeding idempotently.

Copies a file or tree into the complete destination path. Existing directories are merged and regular files replaced. A directory cannot be copied into itself. Individual files publish atomically; the entire tree is not atomic.

Copies a file or tree, then removes source entries from leaves to root. Existing destination directories are merged and regular files replaced. Partial failures remain visible in the job; the whole tree is not an atomic rename.

get.description: Only the original username and UID can read this in-memory job. Jobs survive a browser reload while File Service runs, but not a service restart.
Requires an authenticated request and api_docs.enabled=true. UI assets are served by File Service without a runtime CDN.
